_about: The apps the site is cut into — what someone installs on a phone, and what a desktop pane wears. Each app holds some pages, shows only its own tabs, and is made of some projects (projects.json). This is the ONE list: the frontend (frontend/src/shell/apps.ts), routes/spa.py (the per-app manifests), appmap.py, appboundaries.py and the tests all read it. Keep generic: no personal details, this repo is shareable. See docs/apps.md.

_fields.pages: Address prefixes the app holds: the address itself and every page under it. Each page belongs to one app; the longest prefix wins (/terrain/pond is the Journal's, the rest of /terrain the Observatory's).
_fields.borrows: Exact addresses the app shows in its own shell though another app holds them. A borrow is a crossing, and the boundary map lists it.
_fields.tabs: In order. section = an id from frontend/src/shell/panels/sections.ts (or 'based-foods', the link out). place: bar = always shown, fit = shown while it fits, more = always in More.
_fields.rooms: The Observatory rooms its session list shows; null = every room.
_fields.keeper: Whether the pinned Keeper session shows on its session list.
_fields.projects: Its projects from projects.json. Core is shared by every app and is listed under shared.projects.

shared._about: Pages every app may show, and the code every app stands on.

set_down._about: Addresses routes/spa.py still serves whose pages are in the shed (shed/), or folded into another page. No app holds them; /shed restore brings a page back, and then it needs an app.

based_foods._about: Based Foods is its own app at its own address (config.based_foods_url, EXOCORTEX_BASED_FOODS_URL), linked from the others, never proxied. The rule for what moves there: a feature moves to Based Foods when someone else would want it and it works without the owner's AI setup; everything else stays an exocortex extra. The kitchen project's pages here belong to no exocortex app; each says whether Based Foods already has it (in-based-foods), it still has to be rebuilt there (to-port), or it stays here by that rule (exocortex-only). They stay reachable at their addresses.
